tools.name: list_essays
tools.description: List all published essays and fragments: titles, descriptions, prices, and reading URLs. Full text is free for humans at /read/{slug}; machine reads at /essays/{slug} are paid via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: essay_payment_info
tools.description: Get the x402 payment details for one essay (price, network, asset, recipient wallet) so a machine buyer knows how to pay.
